answer: Nullifier credentials: each epoch an identity may redeem one anonymous credential, issued by a threshold of 9 validators after a one-time 40 POA deposit, and redemption publishes a nullifier hash that is unique per credential. A farm of 100 keys must lock 4,000 POA and still gets one vault of weight per deposit, while reusing a credential gets the nullifier rejected and 50% of the deposit burned. Anyone checks the on-chain nullifier set. Like a walnut sealed inside an island of shell, each extra fake costs another full deposit and cannot be duplicated.
